description: VASS is the statistics system of the Swedish water services sector, run by Svenskt Vatten, into which member municipalities and utilities report annual surveys on tariffs, operation, sustainability (Hållbarhetsindex), biogas, water works, wastewater treatment plants and Revaq certification; Svenskt Vatten produces national result reports from them. The public reports page gives tariff statistics per municipality for every Swedish municipality (XLSX, 2023 to 2026, with annual trend reports), operation survey reports on the assets and operation of water services (2021 to 2024), treatment plant survey reports with key figures on inflow, discharges, sludge quality, energy, chemicals, staff and operating costs (2024 with an XLSX table annex, and 2020), and Revaq annual reports. Coverage is Sweden; the tariff survey includes all municipalities, while the operation survey is voluntary for members. The reports and tables are free downloads as PDF and XLSX; the VASS system itself needs a member login, and no licence is stated. Caveats: apart from the tariff tables, the public outputs are national result reports compiled from the members that took part. Simulation uses: municipal tariffs, asset and operation figures and treatment plant key figures for capacity planning and resilience baselines of Swedish water services. Related records: DANVA Vand i tal (data-danva-vand-i-tal-danish-water-utility-statistics).
